description: Start connecting a customer's Microsoft 365 tenant to Microsoft Viva Learning, so our courses appear in Viva Learning (Teams) as the content source "DelegAIze-Kurse (Innov-AI-tive)". Returns an admin-consent link: a Global Administrator of the customer's tenant opens it, consents to the learning permissions and signs in once more to register the provider; the catalogue is then pushed automatically and synced daily. The customer needs a Viva Learning (or Viva suite) licence. Only tenant admins.

label.description: free label for this connection, e.g. the customer's company name

name: viva_connection_start
